lines.1: 「Speaking of her, look at the school gate.」
lines.2: 「Seen from here, she really has a presence.」
lines.3: 「Yeah. Any suspicious character would turn and run.」
lines.4: 「She makes such a striking picture, yet we never noticed before.」
lines.5: 「We're usually sprinting through the gate or busy talking.」
lines.6: 「Being with you has shown me just how oblivious I am to my surroundings.」
lines.7: 「Because you spend all your time looking at my face?」
lines.8: 「Because looking after you is a full-time job!」
lines.10: The head of the disciplinary committee called us over.
lines.14: She fixed it in one swift motion.
lines.16: 「From the outside, you two look like a couple.」
lines.17: 「Hahaha. Please, Otome, let that ridiculous sword be the only joke around here. This guy isn't even close to my ideal.」
